## Transport timetables and airport shuttles

### On-site transfers

| Time | Transfer |
|---|---|
| Day 1, 18:00–18:20 | JRC Ispra Building 27B → hotels in Angera |
| Day 1, 19:30 | Hotels in Angera → Lido LaNoce social dinner, walking distance |
| Day 2, morning 08:15–08:30 | Hotels in Angera → JRC Ispra entrance check, walking distance, Building 36 |

### Airport shuttles

Departure shuttles between JRC Ispra and the airports or train stations.

| Site | Direction | Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| JRC Ispra | Ispra → Milano Malpensa (MXP) | Participants have received the timetables | If needed, ask the organisers |
| JRC Ispra | Ispra → train stations | Participants have received the timetables | If needed, ask the organisers |

Participants are asked to share their departure times with the workshop
coordination so that shuttle capacity can be planned.

### Access to the JRC site

The JRC Ispra site is an access-controlled facility. Bring a valid photo ID (passport
or national identity card) matching the name used at registration workshop. Allow extra time for
the entrance check, in particular on Day 1 (08:30–09:00).
